description: A React component for rendering various types of select fields in a Mattermost app form, supporting dynamic, static, user, and channel options with asynchronous loading.

classes.name: AppsFormSelectField
classes.description: A React component class for rendering and managing a form select field with support for dynamic options, user and channel selection, and static options.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state with the provided field and a refresh nonce.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Updates the component state when props change, particularly the field and refresh nonce.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles change events from the select component, calling the provided onChange prop.

methods.name: loadDynamicOptions
methods.description: Loads dynamic options based on user input by calling performLookup.

methods.name: loadDynamicUserOptions
methods.description: Fetches user options asynchronously, filtering out bots and formatting labels.

methods.name: loadDynamicChannelOptions
methods.description: Fetches channel options asynchronously based on user input.

methods.name: renderDynamicSelect
methods.description: Renders a React AsyncSelect component for dynamic options.

methods.name: renderUserSelect
methods.description: Renders a React AsyncSelect component for user options.

methods.name: renderChannelSelect
methods.description: Renders a React AsyncSelect component for channel options.

methods.name: renderStaticSelect
methods.description: Renders a static ReactSelect component with predefined options.

methods.name: getAppFieldRenderer
methods.description: Returns the appropriate render method based on the field type.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method that displays the select component and label/help text.
